meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 按 ISO 周拆分项目完整的 claude-mem 历史，再逐周让子代理接力撰写，每章沿用上一章的线索，输出周周相连的连载式叙述摘要。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求“weekly digests”、“week-by-week story”等，或要求按周叙述项目历史时触发。

say.text: 把 [项目名] 的 claude-mem 历史做成每周连载摘要。
请为 [项目名] 生成 week-by-week story。
给 [项目名] 写一份分章的 serial timeline 摘要。

howto.what_en: Makes Claude split a project's full claude-mem timeline into ISO weeks and produce a serial narrative chapter per week, with each weekly agent inheriting the previous week's carry-forward handoff.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for 'weekly digests', 'week-by-week story', or other per-week narrative digests of a project's history.

say_en.text: Turn [project]'s claude-mem history into weekly serial digests.
Write narrative chapters of [project] from start to now.
